versions.changelog:
Initial release – generates standardized skill packages from position-agent prompts.

- Converts each job capability in position-agent prompts into a dedicated, compliant Agent Skill directory with internalized knowledge documentation.
- Requires knowledge sources from Tencent IMA or local files; ensures full knowledge extraction and independence from original sources at runtime.
- Marks and documents knowledge gaps when evidence is unavailable, preventing speculative completions.
- Provides source mapping for traceability of all knowledge and material selections.
- Updates original position-agent prompts to sync with generated skill directories and knowledge docs; maintains a mapping table for tracking.
- Enforces strict output, naming, and self-check requirements for reliability and compliance.
